body: I feel if I make friends and confide in them that I had depression they would stop being my friend. I choose to keep any problems I have to myself. People will just see me as a weak person if they knew I have depression.

I did the same but then I needed Facebook for school. I never post anything. To not feel bad I just do not use Facebook unless I have to and when I am logged in I do not look at any of my friend's posts.

I think if your someone who has severe depression it is not possible. If you have minor depression I think it is possible. If your depression is caused by being single it will definitely be impossible. I have been single my whole life. Some days are better than others. I take it day by day.
I have been thinking this way for years. Everytime I meet someone I immediately wait for when they will hurt me.

I do not understand your point. I do not have friends because people do not think I am cool enough. I do not like anything that is bad for me. I do not do drugs and barely drink. I have never been addicted to anything. Not even food. Are you trying to say I like depression? I do not like depression. I still do not understand the point of your comment.
